rejects.event: A popular fish accompaniment made with Muscadet was invented in Saint-Julien-de-Concelles.
rejects.quote: Made with Muscadet, it was invented around 1900 in Saint-Julien-de-Concelles (on the south bank of the Loire) and has become a popular accompaniment for fish.
rejects.why: The source says it was invented 'around 1900', which is an approximation rather than the exact year 1900.
